title: AGENTS.md Frontmatter (IJFW v1.3.0 alpha, schema=1)
description: Typed YAML frontmatter contract for AGENTS.md. A1 hoists; A3 (Phase 3) populates the project-type fields. compute_trust + compute_net are read by Wayland to set per-project sandbox defaults; env vars override only when explicitly set.

ijfw_version.description: IJFW release that wrote this frontmatter.

ijfw_schema.description: Frontmatter schema version. Bump only on breaking changes.

type.description: Convenience alias for primary_type. Same enum.

secondary_types.description: Additional types A3 detected with above-threshold confidence.

confidence.description: A3 confidence score for primary_type. 0.0 = no signal, 1.0 = certain.

detected_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the A3 detection run that wrote these fields.

signals.description: Human-readable signal labels A3 used to classify (e.g. package_json_present).

compute_trust.description: Per-project compute trust declaration. Wayland honours this for sandbox defaults; IJFW_COMPUTE_TRUST env var overrides only when explicitly set.

compute_net.description: Per-project compute network policy. IJFW_COMPUTE_NET env var overrides only when explicitly set.
